Name: Nikki_and_Momo
Author: kakayeka
Description:
[left][size=6][/size][/left][left][size=6]"The addition of Nikki and Momo from Paper Games' fifth installment of the Nikki series, 'Infinity Nikki,' into the game
The code is provided by the Chinese version of the Stardew Valley mod wiki created by Bilibili user SanSheng Sarv and their friend QinYu Official. Special thanks to both for their contributions.
The art assets were drawn by myself based on in-game assets from Infinity Nikki.Most of the text content was added by myself. Please do not plagiarize.
Some text content is sourced from the fourth installment of the Nikki series, 'Shining Nikki.'
Currently, the mod only includes the character's schedules and seasonal affinity dialogues (perhaps more animated scenes will be added someday).
High-definition portraits are available in the folder and require a portrait mod.
Please do not create any adult-oriented content featuring Nikki. She is a treasure to many.
(If I am no longer available someday and the mod becomes incompatible with Stardew Valley, updates may be made without the need to consult me.)"
